notes: Read all 80 source lines before editing. Replaced the DOM-only imports (L1-L4): forwardRef + ReactNode are kept from react; InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> (L1) becomes the RN TextInputProps base (Omit<TextInputProps,'style'|'id'>); cn from @/lib/cn (L2) becomes StyleSheet style arrays; the ./Label import (L3) is inlined as a styled label row + a required-marker folded into accessibilityLabel; the ./HelpIcon import incl. HelpIconProps (L4) is inlined as a native HelpIcon and the HelpIconProps type is re-exported so callers keep the same `help={{...}}` shape.

Ported InputProps (L6-L25) verbatim in intent: label? (L7), help?: Omit<HelpIconProps,'for'> & {for?:string} (L8-L13), error? (L14), hint? (L15), icon?:ReactNode (L16), suffix?:ReactNode (L17), and size?:'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'auto' (L18-L24 -> exported InputSize). Added explicit `required`, `disabled`, `id` (these arrived via InputHTMLAttributes on web), plus `style` (web `className` for the field) and `containerStyle` (the web outer <div>). The HelpIconProps `className` becomes `style`; `side` is retained for API parity but documented as a no-op because RN renders an inline popover with no directional Tooltip positioning.

Ported sizeClasses (L27-L32) to a sizeStyles StyleSheet keyed sm/md/lg/auto: sm px-2 py-1.5 text-xs -> {ph:8,pv:6,fs:12}; md px-3 py-2 text-sm -> {ph:12,pv:8,fs:14}; lg px-4 py-2.5 text-base -> {ph:16,pv:10,fs:16}. The 'auto' density utilities (px-d-pad-x/py-d-pad-y/text-d-base/min-h-d-row, L31) have no native density runtime, so 'auto' folds to the md metrics plus minHeight:44 to honour the min-h-d-row touch-target intent (rule 7, documented).

forwardRef<HTMLInputElement> (L34) -> forwardRef<TextInput>; the destructure (L35) is preserved and extended with disabled/id/style/containerStyle/onFocus/onBlur/editable/placeholderTextColor so the focus ring, disabled mapping, and id association are component-controlled. inputId = id || label slug (L36) is kept exactly and falls back to a useId()-generated id when neither is supplied so the error/hint nativeIDs stay unique (web would have produced 'undefined-error').

Layout: outer <div className='space-y-1'> (L37-L38) -> View container with gap:spacing.xs. Label block (L39-L50): the flex row -> labelRow (flexDirection row, alignItems center, gap xs); <Label htmlFor required className='text-sm font-medium text-secondary'> -> an AppText label (14/500/textSecondary) with the visible rose `*` kept as a decorative AppText (text-rose-300 -> colors.danger, marked importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' mirroring aria-hidden). RN has no htmlFor/for association, so the Label's VisuallyHidden 'required' text is folded into the TextInput accessibilityLabel ('{label}, required').

Field wrapper (L51) <div className='relative'> -> fieldWrap (position relative, justifyContent center). Leading icon (L52, absolute left, text-muted) -> an absolutely-positioned iconWrap (left:12, vertically centred, pointerEvents none); a string icon is wrapped in <AppText tone='muted'> to mirror the muted colour, a node icon is rendered as-is. Trailing suffix (L72, absolute right) -> suffixWrap (right:12, vertically centred).

The <input> (L53-L71) -> <TextInput ref={ref}>: ref (L54), id (L55) -> nativeID={inputId}; required/aria-required (L56-L57) -> required folded into accessibilityLabel; the className stack (L58-L67) -> StyleSheet array [inputBase (w-full rounded-md border var(--glass-border) bg var(--surface-1) text var(--text-primary)), sizeStyles[size], icon?inputWithIcon(pl-10->paddingLeft:40), suffix?inputWithSuffix(pr-10->paddingRight:40), focused?inputFocused(focus:ring-blue-500 -> accent border via onFocus/onBlur state), error?inputError(border-red-500->colors.danger), disabled?inputDisabled(disabled:opacity-50), style]; placeholder:text-[var(--text-muted)] -> placeholderTextColor default colors.textMuted; aria-invalid (L68) has no RN analog; aria-describedby (L69) -> the active error/hint surfaced via accessibilityHint; {...props} (L70) is spread through so every extra TextInput prop (value/onChangeText/placeholder/secureTextEntry/keyboardType/etc.) flows to the native input, and DOM `disabled` maps to editable={!disabled && (editable ?? true)}.

error

(L74) -> ; hint

rendered only when !error (L75) -> gated on `hint && !error`. Closing/return (L76-L79) reproduced; Input.displayName='Input' (L80) preserved.

Inlined HelpIcon (native): web reveals help on hover/focus/tap via the shared <Tooltip>; RN has no hover/focus pseudo-states, so the `(?)` Pressable toggles an inline help popover on press (accessibilityState expanded, hitSlop 8, testID `${for}-help-trigger`). It renders null when no help text is supplied (web self-gating), and the popover carries nativeID `${for}-help` for parity with the web aria-describedby target. The i18n object-style t() calls (a11y.helpFor / help.tooltip.iconLabel) are served by a useNativeTranslationFallback shim with {{token}} interpolation so 'Help for {{field}}' resolves.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported — only React, RN primitives (TextInput/Pressable/View/StyleSheet), the existing apps/native AppText, and theme tokens (colors/spacing). Verified with `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (added __tests__/Input.test.tsx covering label + value/placeholder pass-through, required accessibilityLabel folding + visible marker, error border + message + hint suppression, hint when no error, icon/suffix padding + muted string icon, the help popover toggle, disabled -> editable false, the 'auto' size min-height, and onFocus accent border).
